title: Rework orchestration interfaces to eliminate routing impedance mismatch
creator: Aisha Malik
description:
Background: Over multiple incremental fixes the routing orchestration layer has accumulated a number of small adapters, global locks, and per-route shims that create an 'impedance mismatch' between high-level policy decisions and the low-level capacity/fallback plumbing. This manifests as increased tail latency during scale-up, complex failure modes during regional failovers, and brittle integrations when adding new policy rules.

Problem statement: 1) The PolicyRuntime (v1) API mixes evaluation, side-effects (route pinning), and metrics emission which makes correctness hard to reason about. 2) Fallback wiring depends on a global mutex to serialize decision transitions causing contention on high-throughput tenants. 3) Regional affinity bookkeeping is duplicated across two services, leading to stale leases and split-brain re-assignment. 4) There's no compact compatibility story for older Dedicated pools during rollout.

Proposal summary: Introduce a v2 orchestration surface that separates pure decision evaluation from mutation and side-effect application. Concretely: - Add DecisionAdapterV2: synchronous pure-eval method that returns an immutable DecisionEnvelope (route, candidate model ids, evidences, TTL). - Introduce an async Applier component responsible for performing mutations (route pin, capacity reservations, circuit toggles) idempotently and with lease-backed coordination per-region. - Replace the single global routing mutex with lease-driven per-shard coordination (lease TTL + renew) + optimistic compare-and-swap for fallback state transitions. - Implement a compact compatibility shim that translates DecisionEnvelope->legacy policy events, enabling a canary path for 10% of traffic. - Consolidate regional affinity code into a single region-agent library and migrate both the routing control-plane and the affinity reconciler to use it.

Goals: - Remove global hotpath contention and reduce median tail-latency under burst by 25% in staging. - Eliminate duplicate regional lease logic and reduce incidence of stale lease reassignments. - Provide a safe, observable migration path for Dedicated pools so we can roll without coordinated downtime.

Non-goals: full rewrite of the policy DSL, changing user-visible routing semantics, or tackling model-selection heuristics in this ticket (those are separate initiatives).

Telemetry/metrics changes required: - New metric: decision_envelope_generation_ms (histogram). - New counter: applier_idempotent_retries_total. - Tag existing routing_latency metrics with coordination_mode: {legacy, lease}. - Emit debugging span with envelope_id for trace correlation.

Rollout plan: 1) Implement DecisionAdapterV2 and region-agent library behind feature flag. 2) Add compatibility shim and route 5% traffic to v2 path in staging, measure decision_envelope_generation_ms and fallback transition success. 3) Ramp to 25% in staging, run load test to verify no global mutex contention. 4) Canary in production with 1 Dedicated pool (off-hours) for 1 week. 5) Full rollout across routing control-plane and affinity reconciler with opt-out via runtime flag.

Acceptance criteria: - End-to-end test coverage for DecisionAdapterV2 and Applier idempotence. - Lease-based coordination replaces global mutex in at least 3 critical hotpaths. - Observability: envelope_id present in traces and new metrics reporting. - Can successfully rollback to legacy path via feature flag within 2 minutes.

Security and compliance notes: Applier will require a review for any mutation flows that touch tenant isolation boundaries; flagging security_review_required.
acceptance_criteria: Applier performs idempotent mutations and records applier_idempotent_retries_total
Global routing mutex removed from hotpath and replaced with lease-based coordination
Regional affinity codebase consolidated into region-agent library and consumed by two services
Compatibility shim available and can route 5-25% traffic with metrics indicating parity
Tracing includes envelope_id and new histogram decision_envelope_generation_ms is populated
tasks: Design DecisionEnvelope schema and protobuf compatibility rules
Implement DecisionAdapterV2 API and unit tests
Build Applier component with lease-backed coordination
Extract region-agent library and migrate consumers
Create compatibility shim and feature-flag wiring
Add metrics/spans and dashboard for new telemetry
Run canary and follow rollback playbook
